q: In physics, work specifies the action (____) and the movement produced by the force.
e: In physics, work specifies the action (force) and the movement produced by the force. Force here means a push or pull that can change a body's state of motion.

q: Work is said to be done when a ____ produces motion.
e: Work is said to be done when a force produces motion. Force here means a push or pull that can change a body's state of motion.

q: Work is defined as the product of force and ____ moved in the direction of the force.
e: Work is defined as the product of force and distance moved in the direction of the force. Distance here means the path length travelled, with no direction. If the force is perpendicular to the motion, that force does no work.

q: The mathematical expression for work done when force and distance are in the same direction is ____.
e: The mathematical expression for work done when force and distance are in the same direction is $W=Fs$. If the force is perpendicular to the motion, that force does no work.
Work is a scalar quantity. Scalar here means a quantity that has magnitude only. A scalar is done once you have the size and the unit.

q: The SI unit of work is the ____.
e: The SI unit of work is the joule. SI writes every quantity as a number times an agreed unit.

q: 1 joule of work is done when a force of 1 ____ moves an object through a distance of 1 metre in the direction of the force.
e: 1 joule of work is done when a force of 1 newton moves an object through a distance of 1 metre in the direction of the force. The physics in this sentence is built around newton.

q: When the unit of force is in pound (lb) and the distance is in foot (ft), the unit of work is ____.
e: When the unit of force is in pound (lb) and the distance is in foot (ft), the unit of work is foot-pound. The unit that belongs with this quantity is foot-pound.

q: When the unit of force is in dyne and the distance is in centimetre, the unit of work is ____.
e: When the unit of force is in dyne and the distance is in centimetre, the unit of work is erg. The unit that belongs with this quantity is erg.

q: The relationship between the joule and the erg is ____.
e: The relationship between the joule and the erg is $1\text{J}=10^7\text{ergs}$. The physics in this sentence is built around $1\text{J}=10^7\text{ergs}$.

q: When the force is constant and makes an angle with the direction of motion, work is defined as ____.
e: When the force is constant and makes an angle with the direction of motion, work is defined as $W=Fs \cos\theta$. If the force is perpendicular to the motion, that force does no work.

q: When the directions of the force and the motion are the same, the angle is ____ and work done is $W=Fs$.
e: When the directions of the force and the motion are the same, the angle is $0^{\circ}$ and work done is $W=Fs$. If the force is perpendicular to the motion, that force does no work.

q: When the force and the motion are in opposite directions, the angle is ____ and work done is $W=-Fs$.
e: When the force and the motion are in opposite directions, the angle is $180^{\circ}$ and work done is $W=-Fs$. If the force is perpendicular to the motion, that force does no work.

q: When the force and the motion are perpendicular to each other, the angle is ____ and work done is zero.
e: When the force and the motion are perpendicular to each other, the angle is $90^{\circ}$ and work done is zero. If the force is perpendicular to the motion, that force does no work.
